links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM outputs across repeated runs (Jaccard)
links.effect: Reproducibility (Jaccard) ranged from 0.74 to 0.93; full agreement ranged from 60% to 89% across models.

links.outcome: Clinically incorrect reasoning and pharmacology errors in LLM outputs
links.effect: Clinically incorrect reasoning ranged from 0% (GPT-5.4) to 27% (DeepSeek R1); of 52 instances, 31 were factual pharmacology errors and 21 conservative boundary-discordant reasoning.
links.quote: Clinically incorrect reasoning rates ranged from 0% (GPT-5.4) to 27% (DeepSeek R1); of 52 instances, 31 were factual pharmacology errors and 21 reflected conservative boundary-discordant reasoning.

links.outcome: Aggregate sensitivity concealing boundary-specific performance differences in RASi omission detection
links.effect: RASi detection at eGFR<15: Grok 85%, GPT-5.4 55%, Gemini 10%, DeepSeek 10%, despite near-ceiling SGLT2i/finerenone sensitivity (97-100%).
links.quote: For RASi, performance diverged at the eGFR<15 boundary: Grok 4.1 Fast 85% versus GPT-5.4 55%, Gemini 10%, DeepSeek 10%.

unlisted_practices: Boundary-specific stratified benchmarking of LLM decision support at clinical decision thresholds

screen.reason: The study develops and executes an automated synthetic clinical vignette benchmark evaluating multiple LLMs on detecting omissions in CKD renoprotective therapy across clinical decision boundaries.
